title: Dnp3MappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the DNP3 adapter mapping. Describes how DNP3 read and control intents are normalized into BASIS authorization requests. Routes match on (operation, point_type); '*' is a wildcard sentinel. Control routes (SELECT, OPERATE, DIRECT_OPERATE, CONTROL) must reference {point_index} in their resource_id_template. Command values are never template fields — they remain protocol evidence.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

Dnp3RouteMapping.description: Maps a DNP3 operation and point type to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

operation.description: DNP3 operation to match (protocol-native function name). Use '*' to match any operation.

point_type.description: DNP3 point type to match, or '*' to match any (including an absent point type).

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default operation→action map is used (READ→read, SELECT/OPERATE/DIRECT_OPERATE/CONTROL→execute, ENABLE_UNSOLICITED→subscribe).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {operation}, {outstation_id}, {master_id}, {source_address}, {destination_address}, {object_group}, {variation}, {point_index}, {point_type}, {event_class} using {param} syntax. Control routes must reference {point_index}. Command values are not available as template fields.
